units: Ber. 60ᵃ, v. רוֹפֵא; a. fr.—Esp. neĕman, one who can be relied upon in matters of tithes and T’rumah; cmp. חָבֵר.
Dem. II, 2; Tosef. ib. II, 2 המקבל עליו להיות נ׳ וכ׳ he who takes upon himself the obligations of a neĕman, must give tithes both of what he eats &c.
<cite ref="Mishnah Demai 4:6">Dem. IV, 6</cite>; a. fr.—Pl. <he>נֶאֱמָנִים</he>, <he>נֶאֱמָנִין</he>. Tanḥ. Vayesheb 5; a. fr.
